headline: South Korean Exports Post Record 50-Year Surge on AI Chip Demand
summary: South Korean exports nearly doubled in October, marking the sharpest jump in over 50 years as global demand for AI semiconductors surged.
why: South Korea is a major exporter of memory chips and technology hardware, serving as a global bellwether for electronics supply chains.

impacts.name: South Korea
impacts.why: Unprecedented export expansion strengthens trade surpluses and economic growth prospects.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Record monthly export performance was driven directly by heavy global buying of South Korean artificial intelligence microchips.
